papers.title: Frolic invitation
lines: A frolic at the Hall on Saturday. Fiddles, stepdancing, a milling table and tea.
Bring your own cup. Bring a plate for the supper. Bring a cousin, because we are short on cousins.

papers.title: Inventor's note
lines: The HD-4 boat flew over the lake on its fins at over seventy miles an hour, which is faster than a horse.
We let the horse know. The horse was unmoved.

trail.clue: A tinkerer left a small toolbox near the lamp post, 'for the next man with a mad idea'.

papers.title: Miner's song sheet
lines: We dig the black coal in the dark, and sing the old songs in the light.
Come up for the Gaelic, stay down for the wages.

papers.title: Road notice
lines: Moose on road. Moose may not read this sign. Moose will not slow down.
Drivers are therefore reminded to be sensible, whatever the moose decides.
